purpose: Test whether the single null-vs-span threshold learned only on SQuAD 2.0 train in v64 transfers unchanged to a disjoint multi-hop answerability domain where locally plausible spans may remain despite a broken reasoning chain.

official_source.evaluation_role: one-time cross-domain mechanism confirmation despite the upstream file being named train
official_source.official_schema_source: raw_data_to_official_format.py at the registered repository revision

model_overlap_disclosure.guard: Exclude a MuSiQue case if its composed question or any decomposition question exactly matches a normalized SQuAD 2.0 train question.

source_access_order: Hash the already-downloaded target bytes without parsing JSONL and register official repository metadata.
Freeze this protocol, then implement and test the adapter, leakage guard, sample selection, blind QA rows, paragraph aggregation, support gates and stopping logic using synthetic fixtures only.
Register protocol, source, model, module, runner and test hashes before parsing any target JSONL row.
Parse the target once, apply schema and leakage exclusions, and freeze one balanced sample without inspecting aggregate support outcomes.
Write all paragraph-level QA inputs without answerability, answers, aliases, decomposition answers, support labels or supporting-paragraph flags.
Run the fixed offline model and aggregate paragraph decisions before joining answerability or other gold fields.
Stop before query generation and BGE/reranker scoring unless every pre-retrieval support check passes.
Publish favorable, null, negative or inconclusive results and never reuse v65 cases for tuning, threshold selection or selector selection.

sampling.ordering: SHA-256('FRC-MUSIQUE-FULL-V65|' + source id), then source id

support_transfer.paragraph_margin: best legal span logit sum minus CLS null logit sum using the fixed v64 QA implementation
support_transfer.case_margin: maximum finite paragraph margin across every official paragraph
support_transfer.decision: support iff case_margin is strictly greater than 0.974609375
support_transfer.multiple_paragraph_comparison_adjustment: none; this deliberately stress-tests direct transfer under multiple local-span opportunities
support_transfer.all_paragraphs_invalid: fail the case closed and count an invalid case

conditional_retrieval.candidate: v36 dual-resource FRC transferred without target tuning

interpretation_limits: Not an official MuSiQue leaderboard result.
Not strict independent model-training confirmation because exact-match exclusion cannot rule out paraphrase, context or pretraining overlap.
Not proof that a max local span establishes a complete multi-hop reasoning chain.
Not an open-corpus retrieval, SetR reproduction, flood-domain or production result.
A positive result remains SHADOW research evidence; a negative result cannot be repaired on v65 cases.
